text:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm kicking off the night-window rollout for search v2 now (22:00 PT). Flag is ff.search.v2. Plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% by cohorts. Need owners, rollback thresholds, and comms.

Alex R: I'll run the toggles and watch deploy-bot. Command I'll use:
```
deploy-bot toggle --flag ff.search.v2 --set enabled=true --cohort 5
```
I'll hit the first step at 22:05 PT. runbook link: /runbooks/ff-rollouts.md :point_right:

Elena (SRE): SLO/rollback anchors: rollback if p50 > 120ms OR p95 > 300ms OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m. I'll have APM and infra alerts open. Also want deploy-bot auto-rollback hook attached.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: toggle ff.search.v2 -> enabled=true cohort=5 at 2026-03-22T22:05:00Z

Sam (oncall): Assigned to monitor telemetry (APM/metrics/dash). I'll post a short checklist 10m before.

Maya: Also pin model route to avoid fallback mismatch: model.route=search@v2.3.1 — do not unpin until rollout complete.

John P (Product): Release note blurb ready: "Search v2 increases recall for long queries; initial night-window rollout 5%". I'll push a small FAQ to #support and DM Steve on duty.

Alex R: First toggle applied.

deploy-bot: Done toggling cohort=5. result: success=true

Elena (SRE): Seeing a small error bump +0.2% on search-api calls; p95 currently 205ms. Within expected range, no SLO breach. continuing to observe.

Sam (oncall): 5m snapshot OK. moving to 20% in +15m unless objections.

Alex R: Applying cohort=20 now.

deploy-bot: Done toggling cohort=20. result: success=true

ops-bot: Quick healthcheck (script): avg p50=95ms, p95=210ms, errors=0.22% over last 5m.

Maya: If p95 > 300ms or errors > 0.5% hold immediate rollback to 0 and pin model.route back to search@v2.3.0. Elena confirm?

Elena (SRE): Confirmed. I'll trigger rollback if p95>300ms sustained for 3 minutes or errors>0.5%. I'll also note cache miss rate — v2 ups context window; KV cache miss currently 3%.

Sam (oncall): Noted, will escalate to oncall-sre if thresholds hit and post in #incidents if we roll back.

Alex R: Planning to move to 50% in ~20m barring issues. Say 'hold' if you want to pause.

John P (Product): Support FAQ posted to #support. small bullet list and suggested responses. :thumbsup:

Maya: Adding deploy-bot auto-rollback hook: `--rollback-on p95>300ms,errors>0.5%` — please attach.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback hook attached to ff.search.v2: conditions [p95>300ms, errors>0.5%], window=3m

Elena (SRE): One minor ask — watch KV backend saturation; increased context size could increase mem pressure on cache nodes.

Alex R: acknowledged. I'll throttle ramp if cache miss rate > 8% or p95 climbs.

Maya: Thanks all. If we make it to 100% I'll post final release note and close thread. If rollback happens, post details & follow-up checklist here. :rocket:
